_comment: Hand-written WRONG or UNSUPPORTED claims (not from an LLM). Citations point at the real span the claim twists, so they get the same premise as real claims. Gold labels in labels.csv.

claims.claim: By default, Retry sleeps one second between retry attempts.
claims.citation: By default, `Retry` does not sleep between retry attempts

claims.claim: The default backoff_factor of Retry is 0.5.
Retry ignores delays requested by the server in a Retry-After header.
claims.citation: it will still respect delays requested by the server when a response includes a `Retry-After` header

claims.claim: A backoff_factor of 0.5 yields retry sleeps of 0.5s, 1.0s, 2.0s.
claims.citation: a `backoff_factor` of `0.5` yields retry sleeps of `0.0s`, `1.0s`, `2.0s`

claims.claim: With exponential backoff, Retry waits before the second attempt.
claims.citation: with no delay before the second attempt (the first retry)

claims.claim: The backoff delays of Retry grow linearly between retries.
claims.citation: you can set a non-zero `backoff_factor` to introduce exponential delays between retries

claims.claim: The default value of backoff_max is 120 seconds.
Adding backoff_jitter removes all randomness from retry delays.
Retrying immediately without backoff is recommended for production systems.
claims.citation: In production systems, retrying immediately without backoff can overwhelm a recovering server
